bio:
Phumelele is a specialist in programme development and implementation at FinMark Trust. She leads the three-year pilot to enhance child support grant recipients' livelihoods through training, skills development, job creation, entrepreneurship, and social empowerment. Passionate about impact-driven initiatives centred on people's development, she draws from her experience in community development and implementing projects for vulnerable groups at a non-profit organisation.

Previously, Phumelele worked as a project manager at the National Treasury's Jobs Fund, focusing on grant funding investments, project implementation, and monitoring MSME support projects. She holds a bachelor of science degree in agribusiness from the University of KwaZulu-Natal and a master of philosophy in development policy and practice from the University of Cape Town.
name: Phumelele Ngcobo
role: Specialist in Programme Development and Implementation
